    • initRequest

      public IuStatefulRedirect initRequest(URI postUri, URI returnUri)
      Description copied from interface: IuSamlServiceProvider
      Initiate an authentication request.

      Creates a pre-authentication session cookie with SameSite=None so that the identity provider can return the SAML response by cross-site HTTP POST. The session handler must issue this cookie with Secure, which requires an HTTPS resource URI.

      Specified by:
      initRequest in interface IuSamlServiceProvider
      Parameters:
      postUri - HTTP POST URI for handling the SAML response
      returnUri - URI to return the user to after successful authentication
      Returns:
      IuStatefulRedirect

    • verifyResponse

      public IuStatefulRedirect verifyResponse(IuRequestAttributes requestAttributes, String samlResponse, String relayState)
      Description copied from interface: IuSamlServiceProvider
      Handles a SAML assertion consumer service POST request.

      Replaces the pre-authentication session cookie with an authenticated session cookie using SameSite=Lax before redirecting to the return URI.

      Specified by:
      verifyResponse in interface IuSamlServiceProvider
      Parameters:
      requestAttributes - Incoming request attributes
      samlResponse - SAML response received from identity provider after user has been authenticated.
      relayState - state value that received back from identity provider after successful authentication.
      Returns:
      IuStatefulRedirect

    • getPrincipalIdentity

      public IuSamlPrincipal getPrincipalIdentity(IuRequestAttributes requestAttributes)
      Description copied from interface: IuSamlServiceProvider
      Gets the authenticated SAML principal.

      Returns null when no active session is available, such as for a new or expired session. An active session that records a failed SAML authentication instead throws IllegalStateException.

      Specified by:
      getPrincipalIdentity in interface IuSamlServiceProvider
      Parameters:
      requestAttributes - Incoming request attributes
      Returns:
      authenticated SAML principal, or null when no active session is available
